newsitem.title: USA: WPS Resources Corp Q3 net declines.
newsitem.headline: WPS Resources Corp Q3 net declines.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
Net income in both periods after $778,000 in preferred stock dividends of subsidiary.

Q3 1996 results reflect $7.4 million increase in operating expenses for startup of non-utility subsidiaries and increased costs at Wisconsin Public Service Corp subsidiary; $1.3 million reduction in gas margins in certain gas supply contracts at WPS Energy Services Inc; $1.1 million expense from conversion to 18-month fuel cycle from 12-month fuel cycle at the Kewaunee Nuclear Power Plant,; and a 5.1 percent drop in residential electric consumption.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Nine-month results for both periods after $2,333,000 in preferred stock dividends.
